name: What steps are involved in professional baseboard installation?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in professional baseboard installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional baseboard installation starts with measuring, calculating linear footage, and checking walls and floors for uneven spots. Trim boards are cut using miter and bevel cuts for outside corners and coped joints for inside corners to ensure tight seams even if walls are not square. The boards are secured into wall studs using finish nails. After mechanical fastening, the crew fills nail holes, applies painter’s caulk along the top seam against the drywall, and completes finish painting so the trim looks seamless and built-in.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes measuring, making miter and cope cuts, nailing trim into studs, filling nail holes, caulking top seams, and applying finish paint.
